```{r}

fix_mojibake <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x)) return(x)
  y <- iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "latin1", sub = "byte")
  Encoding(y) <- "UTF-8"
  ifelse(is.na(y) & !is.na(x), x, y)
}

df_depense_publique_cate <- read.csv(text = getURL("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MathieuScheffer/Projet-Hackaton/Resources/df_depense_publique_cate.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Autres dépenses` = "Autres.dépenses",
                `Autres dépenses sociales` = "Autres.dépenses.sociales")

df_depense_publique_cate <- df_depense_publique_cate %>%
  rename(
    Health = Santé,
    `Old age` = Vieillesse,
    `Other social expenditure` = `Autres dépenses sociales`,
    `Other expenditure` = `Autres dépenses`
  )

plot_ly(
  data = df_depense_publique_cate,
  x = ~TIME_PERIOD,
  y = ~Health,
  type = "bar",
  name = "Health",
  marker = list(color = "#4daf4a")
) %>%
  add_trace(
    y = ~`Old age`,
    name = "Old age",
    marker = list(color = "#e41a1c")
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    y = ~`Other social expenditure`,
    name = "Other social expenditure",
    marker = list(color = "#377eb8")
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    y = ~`Other expenditure`,
    name = "Other expenditure",
    marker = list(color = "#27F5EE")
  ) %>%
  layout(
    barmode = "stack",
    xaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = df_depense_publique_cate$TIME_PERIOD),
    yaxis = list(title = "% of total", range = c(0, 100)),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15),
    hoverlabel = list(namelength = -1)
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

```
